sources.name: load
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; ID="${HATCH_ARG:-}"; case "$ID" in '') F="$D/board.json";; *[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) echo "bad board id" >&2; exit 1;; *) F="$D/board.$ID.json";; esac; if [ -s "$F" ]; then cat "$F"; else printf 'null'; fi

sources.name: save
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; A="$HATCH_ARG"; OP="${A%% *}"; DATA="${A#* }"; case "$OP" in *:*) ID="${OP#*:}"; OP="${OP%%:*}";; *) ID=;; esac; case "$ID" in '') F="$D/board.json";; *[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) echo "bad board id" >&2; exit 1;; *) F="$D/board.$ID.json";; esac; T="$F.hatch-tmp"; case "$OP" in B) printf '%s' "$DATA" > "$T";; A) printf '%s' "$DATA" >> "$T";; C) mv "$T" "$F" || exit 1;; *) echo 'unknown save step' >&2; exit 1;; esac; printf '{"ok":true}'

sources.name: path
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; ID="${HATCH_ARG:-}"; case "$ID" in '') F="$D/board.json";; *[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) echo "bad board id" >&2; exit 1;; *) F="$D/board.$ID.json";; esac; printf '%s' "$F"
